latestVersion.changelog:
Z.AI Vision 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides image and video analysis using the GLM-4.6V model via the Z.AI Vision API.
- Supports OCR, error diagnosis from screenshots, technical diagram interpretation, UI design analysis, data visualization reading, and video scene description.
- Includes Python scripts for both image and video analysis with customizable parameters (model, temperature, max tokens, JSON output).
- Offers detailed setup, error handling, and patterns for batch processing and specialized visual tasks.
- Integrates safety features when run within the `/root/clawd` workspace.
